_schema.subject: Subject text; fills [subject] in the style prompt.
_schema.motion: Motion/camera description; fills [motion] (video/extend only). null = unset.
_schema.input: Default input path(s) for edit/merge. null = unset.
_schema.output: Output path as a string: 'dir/base_name'. Outputs become <base_name>_01.png, <base_name>_02.png, ...
_schema.batch.iterations: Number of images/videos to generate per run.
_schema.batch.grid: Assemble a grid of all outputs (images always; videos require ffmpeg).
_schema.references.ids: Style reference indices from brain/<style>/Reference/ (max 5). IGNORED for video when --start-frame is used (xAI API restriction).
_schema.references.pad: Pad references to the target aspect ratio before sending (true/false).
_schema.image.resolution: Output resolution: 1k or 2k. null = API default (1k).
_schema.video.output_dir: Video-specific output dir override; null = inherit output.dir.
